newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma gives '97 budget second reading.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma gives '97 budget second reading.

text.p: Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament will consider the 1997 budget in a second reading later on Friday, officials said.
The Duma approved the outline figures of the budget, which foresees a deficit of 3.5 percent of gross domestic product, in a first reading on Sunday.

Second and third readings had been planned for December 25, a working day in Russia, but Duma budget committee chairman Mikhail Zadornov has said the committee had proposed the third reading for December 28.
Once passed by the Duma, the budget goes to the Federation Council upper house and then must be signed by President Boris Yeltsin.
The Duma's plenary session is due to begin at 10 a.m. (0700 GMT).
